hero.title: Education, culture, sports
hero.subtitle: We are a Non-profit Organization that develops educational, cultural, social, sports initiatives, guided by Christian values, to walk alongside people in the transformation of their realities.

mission.title: A dream that became a mission
mission.history: Valores Sinaí was born with a clear purpose: to share the gospel of Jesus and extend His love to everyone, using culture, education, sports and faith as tools. We dream of being an open and transformative place where every person can experience the grace, mercy and love of God — not only by words, but through specific actions.
mission.missionText: To share the gospel of Jesus through culture, education, sport, faith and media, providing spaces to encounter and serve so that every person can experience firsthand the love, grace and mercy of God.
mission.visionText: To be a community reference where the transforming message of Jesus reaches every person without distinction, using all available resources — from in-person gatherings at our property to the most modern digital platforms.
mission.quote: "The actions of today will be tomorrow’s testimony. What we do each day can be light and transformation to bless others."

team.title: Our team
team.imageAlt: Valores Sinaí work team gathered together
team.description1: We are a group of collaborators and professionals who share a common vision: building a more united, compassionate and human community.
team.description2: Each member brings their knowledge and efforts to breathe life into our projects, guided by Christian values and a genuine desire to see lives transformed.

president.title: Message from Hugo Alegre
president.name: Hugo Alegre
president.message1: Valores Sinaí was born from a dream God placed in my heart: to be a bridge so that more people can experience the love of Jesus in a real, practical and personal way.
president.message2: Every project, every activity and every gathering is possible thanks to the commitment of a passionate team and the support of those who believe in this vision.
president.message3: I invite you to join this family, to share your gifts, and to be part of a story where God is still at work every single day.
president.signature: With gratitude and hope, Hugo Alegre
president.closingVerse: "Love your neighbor as yourself." — Our guiding verse

values.title: Our values
values.description: We believe values are not abstract ideals — they are decisions we make every day in every activity, retreat and project alongside our community. These fourteen principles shape who we are and how we serve. They are not imposed rules, but the character we choose to cultivate as an organization.

amor.name: Love
amor.description: Our guiding principle. Every activity is born from genuine love for people and their families.

respeto.name: Respect
respeto.description: We value each person as they are, listening to them with care and without judgment.

honradez.name: Honesty
honradez.description: We act with transparency, consistency and commitment in every decision.

paz.name: Peace
paz.description: We foster environments of dialogue and harmony where every person can grow.

honor.name: Honor
honor.description: We recognize the dignity of every person and the integrity of our mission.

lealtad.name: Loyalty
lealtad.description: We stand by our community in difficult moments and in times of celebration.

confianza.name: Trust
confianza.description: We build strong relationships grounded in kept promises and real commitment.

integridad.name: Integrity
integridad.description: We do what is right even when no one is watching. It is the foundation of everything we do.

compromiso.name: Commitment
compromiso.description: We give ourselves fully to every project, because true service is sacrificial.

tolerancia.name: Tolerance
tolerancia.description: We celebrate differences as a source of richness and we make space for every story.

responsabilidad.name: Responsibility
responsabilidad.description: We own the consequences of our actions and we care for the resources entrusted to us.

bondad.name: Kindness
bondad.description: We choose generosity as a way of life, expecting nothing in return.

solidaridad.name: Solidarity
solidaridad.description: We stand with those who need it most, because no one should face their challenges alone.

esfuerzo.name: Dedication
esfuerzo.description: We give our best in every task because honoring God and our community deserves nothing less.
